title: picocli dispatches through a registered child’s edited aliases
summary: Ordinary aliases now dispatch and retire correctly. Registering the primary name itself as an alias and then clearing the alias removes the primary dispatch entry on the merge.

change.description: Updating an attached child’s aliases now updates the parent’s dispatch table.

notes: Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
